mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 69 degrees and overcast at Fireman's Park, and we are looking forward to a full moon tonight. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

A section of Hwy M will be closed for road work from October 5 through October 7, with detours directed to Old PB and Main Street. Additionally, the city reminds residents to be wary of scam emails requesting payment for planning or zoning fees, as all legitimate city communications come from a veronawi.gov address.

We have a busy schedule! Verona Fall Fest is happening today at Hometown USA Festival Park, and live music is scheduled today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol and live music at Paddy Mac's.
On September 5, an officer investigated a report of cheese placed on multiple vehicle windshields around East Harriet and Main Street, which was identified as a viral social media prank.
Culver's is currently closed for a building remodel. Be sure to check back tomorrow, when they open at 10 AM, for the flavor of the day, OREO REESE'S Cheesecake.
